Scenario: Verify home page loads and displays product catalog (Smoke)
Precondition: Browser is open and internet access is available
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to https://practicesoftwaretesting.com/
2. Wait for the page to load completely
3. Observe the product listing on the home page
Expected Result: Home page loads without errors. Product names and prices are visible. No critical error message is displayed.

Scenario: Verify registered user can log in with valid credentials (Smoke)
Precondition: User account exists (customer@practicesoftwaretesting.com / welcome01). User is not logged in
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to https://practicesoftwaretesting.com/
2. Open the login page
3. Enter email: customer@practicesoftwaretesting.com
4. Enter password: welcome01
5. Click Login or Sign In
Expected Result: User logs in successfully. Authenticated UI is shown (e.g. account menu or Logout). No login error is displayed.

Scenario: Verify smoke E2E purchase: add to cart COD checkout double-confirm invoice and My Invoices (Smoke)
Precondition: User is logged in or can log in with default customer. Catalog has products
Test Steps:
1. Log in with valid credentials
2. Add one product to the cart from the catalog
3. Proceed to checkout
4. Enter valid billing: Street Zoey Shore City Hesselbury State Florida Country TG Postal Code 1234AA
5. Select Cash on Delivery
6. On invoice confirmation click Confirm twice
7. Navigate to My Invoices and open the latest invoice
Expected Result: Product is in cart. Checkout accepts billing and COD. Invoice is created only after second Confirm. Invoice appears in My Invoices with correct items and billing details.

Scenario: Verify new user registration and profile information (Regression)
Precondition: User is not logged in. Unique email available (testuser_<timestamp>@example.com)
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to the registration page
2. Register with valid unique email password and required profile fields
3. Log in with the new credentials
4. Open Profile or account details
Expected Result: Registration succeeds. Login with new credentials works. Profile displays information matching registration data.

Scenario: Verify search filter multi-item cart and quantity update (Regression)
Precondition: User is logged in. Multiple products and filters are available on catalog
Test Steps:
1. Log in with valid credentials
2. Search for a product term and review results
3. Apply a category or brand filter and review the listing
4. Add two different products to the cart
5. Open cart and increase quantity of one item
6. Verify cart totals and line items
Expected Result: Search and filter update the listing without error. Both products appear in cart. Quantity update reflects correctly in cart display and totals.

Scenario: Verify login and logout session handling (Regression)
Precondition: Registered user exists. User is not logged in
Test Steps:
1. Log in with valid credentials
2. Confirm authenticated state
3. Click Logout or Sign Out
4. Attempt to open My Invoices or Profile without logging in again
Expected Result: Login succeeds. Logout ends the session. Protected pages are not accessible after logout without a new login.

Scenario: Verify invalid login and duplicate registration are rejected (Regression)
Precondition: Known user customer@practicesoftwaretesting.com exists. User is not logged in
Test Steps:
1. Attempt login with valid email and wrong password
2. Observe error message and session state
3. Navigate to registration
4. Attempt to register using email customer@practicesoftwaretesting.com
5. Submit the registration form
Expected Result: Invalid login is rejected with clear error; no session is created. Duplicate registration fails with clear error; no second account is created for the same email.

Scenario: Verify checkout and invoice failures for empty cart invalid billing and single Confirm (Regression)
Test Steps:
1. With an empty cart attempt to proceed to checkout
2. Add a product to cart then go to checkout
3. Leave a required billing field empty or invalid and attempt to proceed
4. Complete valid billing and COD then click Confirm only once on invoice screen
5. Check My Invoices without second Confirm
Expected Result: Empty cart checkout is blocked or shows error. Invalid or missing billing blocks checkout with validation feedback. Invoice is not fully created in My Invoices after only one Confirm click.
